It is rich in architectural details, which include a centrally located front door that is protected from the weather and, just above it, a beautiful second floor Palladian window. The home at 9 White Oak Lane, just off West Avon Road, features balanced Georgian colonial architecture for the main house that is enhanced by six-over-six windows on the first and second floors with handsome yet simple headers for the first floor windows that elevate its visual appeal. The front door features sidelights and a five-pane transom window while black shutters and crisp white trim contrast nicely with the siding, said Sonia Peck, who is handling the sale of this home with Brigitte Richter, both of William Pitt Sotheby’s International Realty. She added, “I think the strength of the house is its location and how it fits in at the end of the cul-de-sac. When you come down White Oak Lane, the house is majestic with its beautiful flat yard and private backyard. To me, the location, the land, and how it sits on the parcel is beautiful.” 9 White Oak Lane, Avon Brigitte Richter added that, “It’s in a unique location. It’s in Avon but on the border of the Farmington town line and it backs up to Farmington Woods. There are only five homes on this cul-de-sac, so it is a small, quiet neighborhood, very accessible from either Farmington or Avon. It is also close to Avon’s schools, and shopping and dining are all nearby. The location is very convenient.” As for the home, “It is a classic colonial,” said Peck, “with a grand, two-story foyer that has lots of natural light.” The front door’s side and transom windows as well as the large Palladian window above the entry, let the daylight in. Peck added that this foyer, staying true to colonial architectural traditions, also has a beautiful open stairway to the second floor landing, which overlooks the entry, and offers easy access to the formal living room on one side and a study on the other. Shadow boxing on the foyer’s walls and stairway add visual appeal. “The living room is elegant,” Peck said, “while the study is nice and cozy.” The living room features crown molding, which is used through much of the first floor, and French doors that lead to the formal dining room. Hardwood floors, used throughout the first floor, add warmth and beauty. 9 White Oak Lane, Avon9 White Oak Lane, Avon9 White Oak Lane, Avon9 White Oak Lane, Avon9 White Oak Lane, Avon9 White Oak Lane, Avon9 White Oak Lane, Avon9 White Oak Lane, Avon9 White Oak Lane, Avon9 White Oak Lane, AvonShow Caption1 of 99 White Oak Lane, AvonExpand The entry also provides a direct connection to the large eat-in kitchen. It features a large island with an overhang for casual seating. Richter did not hesitate to predict that the kitchen would be the heart of the home. “It overlooks the private backyard and has a slider to an oversized deck that is great for entertaining. It really invites summer parties and grilling on the deck.” The kitchen is also notable for its granite counters, which offer plenty of room for several chefs to work without getting in each other’s way. There is a gas cooktop and double wall ovens. The appliances are all stainless steel while the breakfast area, which has ample space for a large table, is close to the slider that accesses the large rear deck. “It gets plenty of natural light and is a lovely spot to sit and enjoy breakfast,” Richter said. Adding to the kitchen’s visual appeal is beadboard wainscoting and a large passageway to the family room. Here there is a wood-burning fireplace that has been beautifully trimmed, a large window, and a door to the rear deck. Recessed lighting keeps things bright after the sun sets. The formal dining room on the other side of the kitchen features a tray ceiling and more shadow boxing on the lower walls. A half bath and access to the attached three-car garage complete the first floor. Upstairs, there are five bedrooms. The highlight is the primary suite, which Peck noted is oversized with a walk-in closet and a spacious primary bathroom with a soaking tub and spacious separate shower, beautiful raised panel cabinetry, and a large dual sink vanity. “I like the fact that they put the primary suite in one wing of the house to keep it separate from the rest [of the bedrooms],” she said. 9 White Oak Lane, Avon9 White
